t:
It seems that the wandering ghost on the coast of the sea is the spirit of a murdered old fisherman. That is a simple matter. His wife however...
I've read about this sort of thing before... There's another type of spirit, one that is made up of passion and emotions. I can't remember much about it - just that they rarely appear and it's only during the most trying of ordeals. Could it be related to the curse on the castle? Oh, Light protect us from this impenetrable darkness...
I've given the wolf's words a lot of thought and I think he was hinting at the White Knight when he talked about restless bones. The damn rebel claims to be a descendant of Valir, an ancient Kanian king. Could the White Knight have befouled Darkwater through his escapades? Could he have gained control over such a mighty force? Who is he, this White Knight?
Go southeast, to Lukomorie, and see the keeper of the Great Tree. The Great Tree possesses very ancient knowledge and perhaps it will be able to help us. Or maybe give us something to go on, a thread to latch onto so we can find a way to unravel this tangle!
"And day and night a learned cat walks all in circles on his chain." Pure slander! Grr! Like I've got nothing better to do! I sleep at night! And during the day, too.

Grr... Stupid Kanians don't feel it. A horribly evil deed has been committed! Grr! The air is rife with despair. The Valir's name has been stained and spirits are obscuring the Light. But they know, grr, they know all!
Kill Tiberius the Stumbling and report to Luchezar Popov.

Grr! What else do you want? Don't you get it? Spirits have taken over Darkwater! They managed to get even as far as this place, as far as Lukomorie.
There's a spring but it's hard to get to. The satyrs have taken a shine to it and their leader, Tiberius the Stumbling, is standing guard of it. Kill him and you will see!
He who has eyes to see, let him see! Tell the one who sent you about everything that you'll see. One head is good but two are better.
So the leader of the satyrs has been captured by the Specter as well? That's what it is! And I had been wondering why these beasts were so stubborn...

Foulness has enshrouded all of Darkwater. And they, the spirits, hold the answer to our woes.
You say they are silent. I wonder, has anyone managed to communicate with them? I believe it won't hurt to dig around in the local library...
Kill 4 Tree Slugs and Fatso, then speak with the Keeper of the Great Tree.

The Great Tree won't share its seeds easily - not even if an entire archipelago is begging for it.
And besides, The Tree has more pressing concerns. Especially now. It's been besieged by disgusting slugs. And the guards' never make it as far as Lukomorie.
That's not all: one of the slugs has grown to an enormous size. The peasants have even given it a nickname - Fatso. I don't understand what is going on with Nature now!
It's hard for me to ask for this. The slugs are also children of this world. They bathe in the morning dew, letting their bellies be caressed by the rays of the gentle forest sun... But the Great Tree is in danger. That's why I'm asking you to kill four tree slugs and, of course, Fatso. The Keeper of the Tree will be very grateful to you. Perhaps this a heroic deed will even help us solve the problem with the Gibberlings.
What do you think?
Grr! I can feel how worried the Tree is, how its bark squeaks and its leaves flutter. Those vile tree slugs are near again!

Grr! The Tree and I, we are both pleased, very pleased. If I were a simple village cat, I would have licked you for sure. As it is, I don't have anything to give you as thanks. The Great Tree hasn't produced new seeds in a long time. And it will not bear fruit as long as the spirits are defiling Darkwater and the Curse remains on the Castle Blight. Grr!
Bathe 6 pieces of Astral Amber in the Living Spring and report to Andrey Vodopyanov.

Since you're doing so well, I'm going to give you another task. Hmm...
What did that elf say again? "Immerse half in Living Water and the other half in Dead Water..." The ideas those sculptors come up with!
Here are three pieces of amber. Go and bathe the amber in the tavern... No, why would I say that? Did I say tavern?
In the Living Water! The amber needs to be bathed in the Living Water, that's right! And near the Living Spring... there are Satyrs! Drunk satyrs. Hic... Even I don't drink that much.
Anyways... I'm not gonna go and throw myself into their claws. You serve Ivan now, so you can go do it. Go now.
Out there, on paths unknown, are tracks of beasts never yet seen... Yes! Such as drunken satyrs... Hic...
You again? Jeez... I just opened a fresh bottle! Oh, the amber has been washed. That's' good. Hic...
Kill 4 Rotten Treants and Timberbraid in the Fusty Bog. Report back to Dobrinya Nikitov.

I received a message from the Great Mage Aidenus himself. Here, let me read it to you. Alright... No, we'll skip that... This too... Huh! Even the men in our taverns don't use that kind of language! Ugh... How about I just paraphrase?
Aidenus is not pleased with what has been going on here. The White Knight has declared himself a descendant of Valir, an ancient Kanian king, and is making a grab for the throne. White Knight is apparently gaining popularity with the peasants and Aidenus is blaming us! He thinks we're just slacking off instead of bathing our swords in blood!
Such hurtful words! The White Knight went on an expedition to hunt swamp Muskirs in the bog recently. As if it's something heroic. His herald nearly went hoarse singing his praises for an entire week. And to tell you the truth, the Muskirs are still on a rampage. And now the Treants have decided to join them - all because of the Knight's stupid invasion. So instead of repelling new attacks by the White Knight, we have to clean up after him! Here's what I want you do to - kill four angry Treants and their leader, Timberbraid. He's the oldest and meanest Treant in the swamp. Then things will quiet down in the bog.
Don't think of Timberbraid as old and decrepit. He's a mighty and dangerous opponent that has lived in the bog for hundreds of years.
The treants have quieted down? That's good news! And here is your well-deserved reward. But there's still so much to do, so don't wander off.
Kill 4 Swamp Muskirs in the Fusty Bog. Then return to Veleslav Kapishev.

The White Knight is afraid to show his face in Lukomorie. He knows I'll scratch his eyes out! Grr! But we can hear the groaning of the forest from here.
The White Knight has stirred up things in the Fusty Bog. He's on some Muskir hunt! I can sense their anger and spite even here, on the Tree. You need to go put them in their place. Grr! They're making other animals' lives miserable. What if they attack the Tree? And cover it with their spores. We can't let that happen!
Go kill four swamp Muskirs. And then go tell Veleslav the Druid to wake up and get things going over there. The forest needs to be saved from the White Knight's foulness! Tell him that. Grr. And as for me, I need a nap.
What did the Keeper of the Great Tree say? Will he help the Gibberlings?

Save the forest from the foulness! Mother Nature, but this is also my own fondest wish!
Those swamp nimbuses should have been brought to heel a long time ago. But they are just the first step. That White Knight has really made a bad mess of our woods.
Find Ivan's Arrow in the Fusty Bog.

I think I can trust you... Hm... This is a rather sensitive matter, so promise not to laugh! My brothers and I have decided to choose wives for ourselves according to our father's wishes by using the ancient Kanian custom of shooting an arrow from a bow. Wherever the arrow falls, that's where your destiny is.
My elder brother's arrow fell quite well - he married a noble's daughter and is planning to move to the capital. My middle brother got a really lucky break - the arrow fell in Ilona's yard, and Ilona is such a cute dumpling - you can't even fathom her, yummy, finger-lickin' good body!
However my arrow - and I beg you, tell no one - flew through the woods and right into the Fusty Bog. How am I going to find a bride in there? Go there, find my arrow, and bring it back. Please hurry - I think I'll die of shame if people find out about this.
The arrow appears to be in the mouth of the toad. It's unclear what she wants with it, but the important thing is that it's been found. All that's left to do is take it.
Hmm. The toad is keeping its mouth shut so tightly that the arrow can't be removed...
Take the arrow and the toad back to Ivan Gubarevsky.
The arrow will have to be taken back to Ivan together with the toad. He'll have to figure it all out himself.
Oh, damn you to hell! Why did you have to drag this toad back!?
Well, I can't change tradition, but is really my destiny to marry a toad? Oh Tensess, why did you abandon me? Just imagine what it would be like to live with a toad... Oh...
Gather 4 portions of Toad Slime for Agniya Charova.

Now we need toad slime. Urgently. And then we will have... No, I don't trust you enough yet. We'll have a valuable magical experiment - let's just put it that way.
If you do a good job, I'll take you with me! I promise. But for now, bring me the slime from four fat-bellied toads. They live in the Fusty Bog. I would go myself, but I need to soak the bat claws.
They say that toads cause warts - utter nonsense. Just look at me, have you ever seen such soft hands?
Ah, toad slime! And so fatty! How wonderful!
Burn 3 Termite Mounds in the Cursed Thicket for Dobrinya Nikitov.

The White Knight's crusade then took him to the Cursed Thicket. There are forest termites that have lived there for ages and never bothered anyone. But the White Knight decided to go to war with the insects. He killed countless hordes of the termites. But what good did it do?! The termites became so enraged that you can't set foot in the forest now.
But you and I will be smarter. Here, take this flint stone. You'll need to sneak up to the termite mound and set it on fire. Three termite mounds should do it. We'll show everyone who really cares about Darkwater and who only wants to brag!
I have a lot of respect for termites. The queen rules, the workers are busy working, and the soldiers are protecting everyone. A precise chain of command, what a pleasure to see!

If I had the authority, I would have preferred to... uhh... liquidate that herald. We already have to run around and fix whatever the White Knight has botched up, we don't need this guy brainwashing our settlers too!
Obtain 4 Chitinous Shells for the Keen Family.

There are fewer bandits on the road right now, so this is a good time to think of my business.
Everyone around here can't stop talking about the termites that have fouled up the Cursed Thicket. I feel sorry for the wilds, of course, and I feel sorry for the termites, and I feel sorry for the Kanians. But I would feel even sorrier if I were to pass up a profitable opportunity. I think those chitinous shells would go for a nice price in the neighboring regions.
I see you running back and forth all the time. And as sure as I'm a Gibberling, they will send you to deal with the termites. So, why don't you remove their shells while you're at it? I'll expect four of those from you. There's no rush, but if you happen to find yourself near the termite mounds, remember the Keen Family who's been robbed by those evil bandits.
Deal?
You can get a lot of money for those shells! As soon as I can stand up I'm going to the capital. Who knows, maybe one day I'll have my own store!
Thanks! If you feel like improving Kanian-Elven-Gibberling relations again, talk to me. I know all the sure-fire ways to do that.
Kill 4 Monstrous Termites or Hulking Termites, and their leader Babariha. Report to Veleslav Kapishev in Valir Settlement.

Alright then, let's start saving the forest.
Our first target is the Cursed Thicket. It's so bad I see it in my nightmares... Horrible things have been going on since the White Knight passed through there. Birds aren't singing, wild berries aren't reaching for the sun, and even large animals are avoiding the place. It's all because the forest termites went on a rampage, taking over everything and fouling things up. We need to save the wilds!
We won't destroy all of the termites, but we need to reduce their numbers. Find the giant termite nest and go down to the very bottom. Kill four workers or soldiers, along with their queen. The folks here call her Babariha. The Cursed Thicket will then have a chance to recover while the termites are raising another queen.
Those termites are resilient creatures. I wouldn't be surprised if they were the only things to survive after the next Great Cataclysm.
The termites are defeated! May they live in our memories forever. Luchezar here talks about the Light a lot. As far as I'm concerned, it's you that is bringing the true light to our land, not him!
Go down into the termite nest and kill Roman Korenev for Veleslav Kapishev. Also destroy 4 Magical Termite Eggs.

This next task is particularly sad. One of my own colleagues, a druid, has gone rogue.
My friend Roman Korenev, when I saw him last time, was about to go to the Cursed Thicket to aid the White Knight with his "exploit". He was pursuing his own aim, too - to create a termite army using the druid magic.
I admit I had to stop him, but I said nothing to object. Now I'm a bit scared about what awaits the Darkwater. What's it going to be if his idea works out?
Please, correct my mistake. Find Roman and make him stop! And you'd better destroy the termite eggs before they hatch...
How terrible. No one can go against the laws of Nature.

So, Roman has been defeated!
The purity of this world has been redeemed with blood once again. Is the blood the sole measure of the world balance? Will the world washed by it still be worthy of existence?
Nevermind my grumbles. I always am in doubt. I am grateful to you.
Bathe 6 pieces of Astral Amber in the Dead Water for Andrey Vodopyanov.

"Where there is Living Water, there's also Dead Water." Hic... That's what that mage said and that's the second part of the ritual, according to the instructions, half must be bathed in the Dead Water. Uhh...
The spring is way out near the Kudykin Altar. When I found out... Hic... That Dead Water was required, I decided to forget about the whole thing and stay here! But you... Hic... You can give it a shot. Good luck! And come back if you're able.
I wouldn't go near that cyclops... Jeez...
How was the walk to the Dead Water spring? Hic... This calls for a drink!
Bring 4 Sugar Canes for Ivan Gubarevsky in Valir Settlement.

Just because you've married a toad doesn't not mean that the worst is behind you.
I thought I'd pour some dishwater into a basin for my betrothed and let her live in a storage closet somewhere. Just as long as no one knows about it. Unfortunately, my father wants to meet his daughters-in-law. He wants each of them to bake him a big loaf of bread. Can you imagine this bug-eyed creature baking? Neither can I.
No, I don't trust you with this. I'll brave the oven myself! It would be a great help if you could bring me four sugar canes, however. They like the sun, so you'll find them wherever trees don't grow. Your best bet would probably be the Kudykin Altar. And above all, keep quiet about this!
My mother always added sugar cane to her bread. The guests would stuff themselves so much, they couldn't get up from the table.
Thanks so much! I'd make some extra for you, but I'm in a bit of a hurry right now.
Find 4 June Mage's Tablets in the ruins on the Kudykin Altar and bring them to Luchezar Popov in Valir Settlement.

The Light's grace is still with us! I dug around the library and was able to find something. A few rare books.
One of them mentioned the spirits of passions. Much of the volume had been gnawed by mice but, by the Light's mercy, the disgusting rodents left the most important part alone. I managed to make out the description of an ancient ritual! Perform it and you will be able to communicate with spirits. Soon we'll find out what's really going on here!
The ritual requires magical June tablets, though. The Junes practiced the now forgotten art of blood magic: they wrote incantations on tablets with blood. Back in the day I was quite interested in it...
Fortunately, there are June ruins everywhere, even in an out of the way place like Darkwater. So your path lies to the northeast where the forest opens up to a great altar. The Kudykin Altar. It's where you will find the tablets - we'll need four of them.
In the meantime, I'll go back to the library and try to find something about Valir's descendants. Together we'll find the truth about that White Knight!
People often find magic tablets in the June ruins, and Light willing, we'll be lucky too.
The Light has illuminated your path! We now have the tablets, and that is what's important. Just a few small details remain.
Tell Luchezar Popov about Gorislav Mudrov's mournful tale.

I once rode around like a noble knight fighting enemies, and now I've become such a monster that even bats recoil from me... It's all because of her - that thrice damned witch! She twisted my father around her little finger, bewitched him! It's painful to even think about it, but I'll tell you the whole story.
My mother died and left our poor father to look after twelve sons and a beautiful daughter. Our father did not remain single for long - he soon remarried a servant from the castle who said her name was Maria Kramolskaya.
She brought along her own son, Miroslav, who grew up to become the White Knight. He's not a hero of legend, but just a regular Kanian, the same as I used to be...
My stepmother soon drove my father into an early grave and that was the end for his children. I had a squabble with her brat and beat the tar out of him. She used her powers to turn me into this monstrosity in return.
That witch swears that the Valir's blood runs in her son, and claims that his father was the master of the castle himself. I refuse to believe that the Valirs could produce such a monster.
It turns out that Maria Kramolskaya is none other than Baba Yaga. Right now she's probably hovering someplace near her dearest son and plotting her vile crimes against the citizens in the settlement.
Right now she's hiding in these ancient ruins and she sent me here to guard the entrance. She must be afraid of something, but I do not know what...
You managed to speak with the ghost? Incredible! Tell me, what did he say?

Oh, shame on me! I have studied all of the branches of the Valir family tree and have never found any room for the White Knight in there, but it never occurred to me that he could have been a bastard. I'll have to reconsider things.
Collect 4 Slimy Whiskers for Agniya Charova.

There's not much left to do now! Soon it'll be possible for us to start the magical experiment!
My cauldron is boiling. I'm so excited. The only thing missing is slimy whiskers. I need four of them. You'll have to go to the Kudykin Altar, it's the only place where those creatures exist. I'm warning you, this won't be an easy trial, but I have faith in you! And besides, I have no one else I can send.
I think it would probably be more profitable to raise one's own millipede instead of dragging oneself to the Kudykin Altar after them every time. It's worth thinking about.

Oh my, what would I do without you! Just wait one second - I need to get everything ready for the experiment. I'm not too sure I should be bringing you with me. This is very dangerous! But I'll consider it so come by later.
Talk to Agniya Charova in the Settlement.

We have the June tablets, but now we need the following things to perform the ritual - bat talons, toad slime, sea crab hearts...
What? The witch had sent you for these things? Hm... I underestimated her... Country gals usually only come to her for love potions, so I figured, fine, let it be. Fighting this is like trying to eradicate the custom of hanging clay pots on fence posts. But it turns out that Agnes isn't so simple after all! How can she already know the things that had taken me so many years to learn from the wisest of men after having read through entire libraries of dusty tomes?
Go to her and find out what she's about. Could she be planning to communicate with spirits too? Glory to the Light in the middle of darkness!

So, Luchezar sent you to me, a simple country quack? Why didn't the Light, or darkness, grant him its wisdom?
Do you know that in his youth Luchezar was very interested in all kinds of forbidden magic? And then when the Church issued its Order against it, he was the first to get scared and sign up to be a priest!
So what does he need?
What?! Luchezar also wants to learn to communicate with spirits? How does he know about my ritual? Yes, this is my ritual, mine! I drew it out of the hag herself!
Perform the ritual in the witches' circle and report to Luchezar Popov.

Oh, fine, I'll tell you the whole story - I wouldn't have been able to do this without you anyway. The thing is - I was once a servant of that Kramolsky and his mother, but I left them long ago.
The old woman has hidden herself deep in the woods and I don't like the things she's doing out there, not one bit. However, when I was young, I learned many things from her, sometimes without even understanding what they truly were. I've thought about replicating one of her rituals for a long time now so I can speak with the ghosts.
Since you and Luchezar are doing the same thing, I'm going to help you with your ritual. It'll be better this way - freeing Darkwater from this curse is no joke.
You must perform the ritual in the witches' circle that lies deep in the Werebear Grove. There's a tiny island between the streams with a pile of stones on it. Touch the central stone to summon the evil spirits, and do your best to defeat them.
Good luck! I hope you won't bear any ill will towards me if anything goes wrong.
The witches circle is a good place for a ritual since it's far from the village and people. What won't I do to save Darkwater. May the healing Light deliver us all!

I can feel that patches of light have started showing through the clouds over Darkwater. It's about time! Now you'll be able to communicate with the ghost when you meet with it again. And this will happen soon - I have no doubt.
Deliver the lost letter to Dobrinya Nikitov.

Listen to this horrible story I've just heard! They say the old hag Evdokia murdered her husband for his money. Can you believe that?
Anyway, I have a job for you. One of my owls flew in all covered in blood with a sealed scrap of paper attached to her foot. It was the seal of Aidenus himself! The letter was lost somewhere in Amalthia Woods, where all those damned ravens are.
If you happen to be in those parts and find a letter in the woods, take it to Dobrinya Nikitov as fast as you can - it's probably something important for him from Aidenus.
Efrosina told me that Aidenus' letter has disappeared in Amalthia Woods. I don't want to know more, but that letter must be found!
The letter's been found? Oh, my hands are shaking. Well, what are you going to do... we'll have to unroll it and read it. There's no avoiding this.
Bring the Xadaganian Rug to Ivan Gubarevsky.

Does anyone else have a wife like this? Instead of warming the bed at night, she just sits there making bug-eyes at me and croaking. She's cold and slimy. I wish I could just leave it all and go join Andrey at the tavern!
But no, my father has come up with a new test. He decided that he needed to see how good his daughters-in-law are at weaving. I managed to make that loaf of bread, but weaving is a complex skill!
Fortunately, I heard that the werebears in the Werebear Grove recently attacked a wagon train. They say there was a real Xadaganian rug in the cargo. Can you guess where I'm going with this? We'll say that it's the work of my wife!
The rug must be somewhere in the den of the werebears. Their leader is a powerful, old, and experienced werebear. They say that he hoards all of his treasures in his cave. He must have it! Go to their den, kill the chief, and take the rug. I'm sure you can handle it.
I don't know how much longer my father is going to torment me. I hope that the rug is the final test. Then I could finally become a widower...
Once again, you're a life saver! How I hate this family life!
Obtain 4 Bear Idols in the Werebear Grove for the Keen Family.

Things are looking up! There's another rarity that can only be found here in Darkwater and sold at a good profit out of the forest.
Here's the deal. The local werebears worship idols. They're very devout in their worship: won't take their eyes off those idols even for a second. So it's a difficult task - you'll have to battle the werebears in order to get those wooden trinkets. But it's worth it! Collectors pay a lot for bear idols, and I will give you a good reward in return for four idols. You won't regret it.
Wooden idols are in fashion right now, but only if they're in good condition! They can't be scratched, chewed, or bitten!
I can imagine how bad the bears' feelings were hurt... Or how happy the customers will be! And here's the reward, as promised.
Participate in killing Nessie and report back to Foma Krytov.

There's a story in these parts that's been around for years. It may seem like just some tall tale, but the proof can be found by taking a walk along the Astral coast.
In the sea there lives an eerie monster. No one knows how it came to be. Probably, it is a mutant created by living too close to the Astral for years. One of the visiting elves took a look and named it "Nessie".
Now that the lands of Darkwater are being cleansed it might be time to cleanse our sea of this monster! Now, don't even think about going after Nessie alone. You'll need to assemble an entire team of allies. Once you gather your most trusted friends, go to the Lukomorie and take this thing down!
Have you seen how it attacks?! What a terrible beast.
It can't be! Now we can go fearlessly into the sea to admire the beauty of the water rushing off the allod? Your name will be remembered for this feat!
Participate in defeating Valuy and report to Veleslav Kapishev.

Deep in the swamps of the Fusty Bog lives Valuy - a giant mushroom. He is the essence of rot and decay and his children have all but taken over the swamp. Here is the source of the infection! Here is the rotting core of Darkwater! But coping with him will be difficult, you won't be able to go into his swamp with just a basket and a knife!
You'll need an ax, a sword, a halberd! You'll need a team! Only through a joint effort can you overcome Valuy. So, what say you?
The Fusty Bog... Awful place! And it's all because of Valuy!
Can you feel it? The air is cleaner! The stench of Valuy's poison no longer hangs in the air!
Dig around the unusual Astral amber.
Oh. Well, isn't this strange! This cluster of Astral amber looks different from all the others, maybe it's worth a lot more! You should dig it out and see what sort of loot you've found!

Aha! There was a chest buried underneath. No wonder the amber looked so different. It was sitting on a chest instead of regular old soil. Many thanks to that poor soul that buried his treasure here and then forgot about it.
Find the hidden treasure to the east and report your success to Andrey.

I've heard rumors about there being a... hic... a treasure at the bottom of the sea. I've told other travelers about it, but they all shrugged me off as a crazy old drunk... hic! It's their loss in the end, serves them right.
But you, I can tell you're different. I can tell by... hic!... by those kind eyes that you know Andrey ain't fooling you.
I can't give you any more information than that... hic! But I know it's out there, that's for sure. You should go find it and share the wealth with this ol' buddy of yours... hic!
Great! Hic... Now that you're rich, how about buying your buddy a drink?
Bring 5 Rare Saddles to Foma Krytov.

You there! You're a leatherworker, right?
We're fighting the curse! We need all our horses harnessed for a blistering breakthrough or a fast march-back! And that's where you come in. I'm sure you'll be able to find some way of getting your hands on a leather saddle. Find us some good saddles by any means necessary! The citizens of Darkwater will never forget you if you help.
We're organizing a militia, and we will strike a great blow to Darkwater! But first, we must obtain saddles to tack up horses...
Ah! You did it! Thank you so much!
And what is that made of? You're not sure?! Well, alright, give it here anyway...
Father 4 sprigs of firetop and bring them to the Druid Zamyata Lovenoff.

Ah, what a beautiful day... The air is filled with languid warmth, nature is flowing with sap... Can you feel that?
This is all thanks to Ivanov Night. A night of love, a night when all dreams come true - it's a very old Kanian festival. You need to find your other half in such night. True love really exists and some lucky people can find it. Yes...
Darkness that fell over Lupinwood cannot disrupt this ancient fest. This is why I'm here. I'm sure Ivanov Night will help us dispel the darkness.
You can help me! And maybe I can help you.
Go to the forest and gather 4 sprigs of firetop. It's not hard to find them. Bring them to me, and then we'll continue our conversation.
Firetop... An ordinary forest grass... But sometimes it can perform miracles! I know better. Haha...
Wonderful, do you feel the smell? It makes me excited? Humbleness and strength...
When you get the key, get into the bath and pour Love Potion to the bath oven. When the results of Ivanov Day are revealed get back to Zamyata Lovenoff.

I throw parts of Firetop in the water.The water will take the power of forest grass. A power of Love.
Potion is ready. You can try it if you want. Take it. Open a door with a key, come in and pour it on the bath oven. Be all eyes!
Boys and girls from settlement are waiting. They are full of youth and joy! Let their wishes come try! Ivanov day! Finally it came!

I'll exit the steamy sauna,
Stand on the silky leaves with my ivory feet,
Blow in all directions,
And summon all eight winds,
I shall bid them to fly into open country,
To meet there a white gyrfalcon,
And tell him a secret mysterious
Of my love for the whole wide world!

Here you are.
Regrets... It is pity that this Ivanov Day is not your day! You were not able to find your lover. A lonely night it will be...
Enter the bath and test your fate once again. Then say goodbye to Zamyata Lovely Druid.

Wait! We still have a chance! Ivanov day is naughty and playful. And in most cases your patience would be paid. Enter the bath one more time. Maybe Love will show her mercy and open the doors of pleasure.
Don't be afraid. It's better to regret about what you've done than about missed opportunities.

Fair winds, carry my magic words,

Seal them under seven locks,

seven doors, give a key to a whale in the ocean,

And he will hide it under seven seas...

It was a great job! You were also gifted in Ivanov day!
Go now. Other also want to test their fate. I need to talk to them. And always remember about Ivanov day! A day when Freedom and Love were with you!

When a new Astral level opens, the level of current equipment is increased, and so does the strength of the enemies that you might encounter on your various adventures. To avoid falling behind, you will need to obtain equipment of the current level.

But there is good news, too: if you have equipment of previous levels, its level may be increased to the current one by using a Scroll of Reinforcement.

Create a Scroll of Reinforcement on the anvil and test it by increasing the level of one of your equipment items to the current one. To create the scroll, you will need the ingredients you're already familiar with: Crafting Parts, Enchanted Dust and Amalgam.

If you have no more items of a previous level - it's not an issue: I'm ready to sell you something from my stocks. Just recently, a hero brought me a whole pile of old equipment, and sold it to me wholesale for a song. His name was Gennady, or Gerasim, or something... he was looking calm and short of height, too, but rumors had it that he's a real butcher when it comes to hard action. No wonders I had to scrub the armor clean of blood, slime and Tensess knows what else - but I decided to avoid asking questions.
Follow the Relic Master's instructions to craft a Hero's Insignia on the Anvil of Artifacts and upgrade the equipment.

Greetings! I'm responsible for teaching worthy heroes the basics of working with equipment. I have to do something besides hammering over the anvil, right?

First off, put on any kind of new equipment. You can obtain it, for instance, by defeating powerful enemies in the Adventures on Astral allods.

Then I'll be telling you about creating a Hero's Insignia, which would be useful for upgrading your equipment.

You will need several components for this: Enchanted Dust, Amalgam, Crafting Parts and a Sign of the Hero's Insignia.

Let's begin with the Enchanted Dust and the ways to get some of it. Shall we start?

Ah, youngsters... We have to explain everything to you! Back in the day, we learned it all by trial and error. And we're still alive and kicking, as you can see. All limbs are accounted for. Ah, well, no use talking now...

Excellent, then. Now you know everything a hero might need to know about creating Insignias.

If you have questions about daily quests, just ask me, I'll explain everything again.

Who are you without your equipment? The great hero of Sarnaut, the vanquisher of Gods and the defender of common folk? That is not something one can take away, but to continue on the path of great deeds, you will need to develop yourself and become better. The same applies to your items and artifacts.

The Relic Master is the one who can help you with that - and you can go and visit him now so that you might be taught the secrets of maintaining your mighty power.

h: Tell me about the Training Camp explorers

t: The Zem had very tricky machinery. Very hard to handle. But don't worry, the research is well under way. The researchers are dismantling the gears and hinges. I can sell you the things they're done studying.
h: Tell me about the initial research results

t: The results are rather curious, comrade! The more we study the complex devices, the more interesting they get. The Zem did amazing things. All their machinery was meant to pull the life force from the living beings. The Training Camp was the facility where they studied feeding the life energy to the dead things. They animated them without any other power sources! We're so excited to continue the research. As for you, you have our gratitude and a couple of curious things.
h: Tell me about the extensive research results

t: What can I say? It's a real scientific breakthrough. I can't believe we failed to figure it out earlier. You're one of us now, so you should be prepared for the truth! Here we go. The Training Camp was a facility where they studied leeching life from the living things and redirecting it to the dead. All golems and other clockwork monsters were inactive for many years - until people came and started killing one another. The blood was spilled. It gave new energy to the golems. You know what, I think you should keep it secret. We don't want anyone to interfere with our research by claiming it "unethical". As for you, I expect your silence in exchange to access to all our findings. Enjoy!
h: Tell me about the final research results

t:
What do you know about the Training Camp? Nothing? I thought so. Don't get upset, none of us knows enough. That's the problem, the Zem heritage is huge, and it has a lot of mysteries, hunted for by the League. We shouldn't let them lay their hands on it! Our special research team will take care of all findings. Would you like to lend us a hand? The Empire will make it worth your while! We'll give you access to all our latest findings. Well, are you interested?
Are you willing to help? You will receive payment in Training Camp Explorer tokens, which you can spend on different things we find there or donate to increase your reputation. Help your Motherland, comrade, and the Motherland will help you.

h: Tell me about the Sculptor's disciples

t: Did you feel something? Is someone watching you? That's right, Sculptor watches the fights. Studies. Judges. The ultimate goal is not a victory or conquer. The Sculptor seeks knowledge. It's still too early for you to know it all. Don't get upset, though. I can offer you Sculptor's gifts that will come in handy. That would be all.
h: Tell me what's going on in the Tower of Order

t: Information is valuable in itself. The ultimate goal is the experiment. You could also call it a sociological experiment. We watch you fight, and we can control the course of the battle. We change conditions, study your reactions, and make conclusions. I can't tell you anything just yet. In the meantime, I'm offering you the latest gifts of the Sculptor as a reward.
h: Tell me what the Sculptor wants to know

t: It's time for you to learn the truth. The Creator's mission is to put an end to the world. He conceived all living beings as destructors. He wanted us to destroy the world that was his prison. And that's exactly what we're destined to do, early or late. The question is, what are the odds of us putting an end to Sarnaut? How bad is our inclination toward self-destruction? That's what the Sculptor tried to figure out. The outcome: the Creator gave birth to chaotic creatures with free will. Conclusion: the world will be destroyed. Or not. It's half and half: we either destroy the world or not. On Creator's behalf, I express my gratitude for your kind assistance. It will be rewarded with the most interesting Sculptor's gifts. That would be all.
h: Tell me what the Sculptor found out

t:
We are the Sculptor's Disciples. There is nothing to fear – we have no affiliation to the fanatics from Dane. We won't talk about our goals yet. We're offering a deal. Tower of Order. You know that place, right? Go there and fight. You will receive a special reward for your efforts.
Deal? Then this is what you need to know: you will be rewarded with Sculptor Shards. You can exchange them for goods or give them to me for free – that will increase your reputation. Defeat any strong enemy in Nihaz's Citadel.

During the Battle for Ambrosia, trap enemies 5 times.
Complete the Hare Race on Irene in less than 3 minutes 20 seconds.
Complete 10 distortions of the actual sector without letting your health drop below 75%.

Use Jinn's Shadow to protect at least 10 players from Wrath of Ifrits at the same time.

Deliver Seeds of Power to the target 2 times during one Battle for Ambrosia.
Open 2 antique chests in Al Rihat Ruins without dying or leaving the zone.

Be in the team of players on the ship that stabilizes the Protopower Emanation gained for victory of the Archdemon.

Perform 5 synchronized stunts with a group of 3 players when skating at the Winter Resort. Players must be in the same group and within 50 yards of each other.

Search 15 chests on the Melting Isle.
Purchase an alchemy manual from Sarbaz Losash and read it. Purchase a wooden Pestle and use it to prepare common stain remover. Report to Sarbaz Losash.

Excellent! It's encouraging to know that you've picked up a book to learn more about alchemy. Since you're so eager to get started, why don't you learn on the spot by helping me with a job.

I'm extremely busy at the moment and would definitely appreciate any help I could get. You can assist me by cleaning out these filthy Imperial uniforms. I'll need you to create stain removers. The last thing we'd want is for Yasker to notice that the Imperial Army is not keeping up to their grooming standards.

All you have to do is purchase an alchemy manual and a tool from me.
Can you read? Do you understand what you read? Good. I need a stain remover, not a hole in the ground instead of the tower.

Hm, it looks fine... Let me check it out.

Wow. A bit too concentrated, to my taste, but generally fine. Well done! Keep going. I've got another task for you.
Purchase a Sickle and Ether from Sarbaz Losash, obtain five Potent Chamomiles and brew 5 Weak Potions of Healing. Report to Sarbaz Losash.

We receive orders from military hospitals pretty often. For instance, here's one from the Holy Land. They're running out of healing potions. Let's see... they are asking for five weak potions of healing. That's the task for you.

You have a good chance to learn an important lesson: best ingredients are gathered by the alchemist. Oh well, that's rather easy, they're everywhere. Of course, you may buy them from an auction, too. You will need Potent Chamomiles for your potions and Ether. Collect five flowers and buy Ether from me.
Our soldiers should rely less on the Gift of Tensess, really.

These are good potions! You know what, you may leave them for yourself. You're a hero, alright! I'm sure you're going to make good use of them. I can brew potions for the soldiers myself.

Welcome to the ranks of alchemists! Now you know everything that an apprentice should know.
My name is Sarbaz Losash. I started studying alchemy a very long time ago, all the way back in my past life. I can tell you anything you need to know on the subject.
What do you need so much suspension for? Are you drinking it, or what? Alright, take it, before I change my mind!
Purchase an alchemy manual from Sivoyar Zablosky and read it. Purchase a wooden Pestle and use it to prepare common stain remover. Report to Sivoyar Zablosky.

Do you want to learn alchemy?

I'm not sure, I haven't been teaching for ages... Then again, why not! It isn't Astral demon's biology, after all. Pay for your manual, tools and initial ingredients, and we can start our training.

For starters, prepare common stain remover for me. It's a good exercise, and besides, we have a customer! Gibberling captains made the order, they grumbled something about never taking a herd of 200 cows on board again.

Read the manual further, otherwise you might brew or cook something really dangerous... like this last time, when one talented student of mine made a mistake and cooked a piece of Astral in his flask, and was swallowed whole by it.
Hm, I wonder... It's not acid or deadly poison... Look at that, a common stain remover! That's huge success, for a start.
Purchase a Sickle and Ether from Sivoyar Zablosky, obtain five Potent Chamomiles and brew 5 Weak Potions of Healing. Report to Sivoyar Zablosky.

Don't you think that alchemy is only about using free ingredients for your potions? No way. Alchemy is a complex art, in which brewing is merely a final part of the sequence. You will have to learn all about herbs finding, gathering and combining.

You will need a sickle to collect herbs. I've got one, it's ok for an initial training, and it's cheap. Find five Potent Chamomiles here, in Lightwood, and use them to brew Weak Potions of Healing, just to begin to understand what alchemy really is. Be patient as you pick up herbs, it might take a while, but it's totally worth it. Or, if you're pressed in time and have some money, you may simply buy it from an auction.
All kinds of healing potions are very popular these days.
All done? The color seems to be right. Go on, take a sip... what does it taste like? Rotten cabbages? That means the potion is good. Welcome to the ranks of alchemists.
